title: Combat
bodyHtml:
Short and expensive. Each round costs half an hour off the road and each tactic burns something.

  • Fire: shot, one charge per shooter.
  • Hold the line: costs only blood.
  • Torches (2): devastating against the Hollowed and beasts, useless against men.
  • Signal rocket: may break their nerve.
  • Pay them off.
  • Run: cargo is dumped.

Enemies scale with distance travelled. Humans can break and flee; the Hollowed do not. Eight enemy types are listed on Content catalog.

Files: src/game/combat.ts, content/enemies.ts. The 3D staging is in web/src/scenes/combat.ts (see Web client).
